# telnyx_traffic_policy_profiles (Data Source)

Lists traffic policy profiles, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_traffic_policy_profile`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_service` (String)
- `filter_type` (String) One of `blacklist`, `throttling`, `whitelist`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String) One of `-service`, `-type`, `service`, `type`.

### Read-Only

- `traffic_policy_profiles` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--traffic_policy_profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--traffic_policy_profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `traffic_policy_profiles`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `domains` (Set of String) Array of domain names.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `ip_ranges` (Set of String) Array of IP ranges in CIDR notation.
- `limit_bw_kbps` (Number) Bandwidth limit in kbps.
- `record_type` (String)
- `services` (Set of String) Array of PCEF service IDs included in the profile.
- `type` (String) The type of the traffic policy profile.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.
